prompt.intro: You are shown two screenshots of a browser 3D racing game, labelled Image A and Image B. Both are taken at the same moment of the same recorded run (same track position, same speed), with the on-screen HUD hidden. One may be from a shipped game and the other from an independent re-implementation, or both from the same source; you are not told which.
prompt.question: Question: do the two images show the SAME GAME DESIGN: the same track layout and scenery layout, the same kind of vehicle, and the same overall look-and-feel and art-direction family, even if rendering quality, textures, models and effects differ in detail? Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, with these keys: "same_design": true or false; "confidence": a number from 0 to 1; "matches": up to three short phrases naming what is the same in both; "differences": up to three short phrases naming the most important differences.
